title: DIAL M FOR MOON — Hook A: The Call
tagline: ONE FREQUENCY. TWO EMPIRES. NO SIGN-OFF.
concept: In media res at the night switchboard: Valya answers a dead jack and a voice speaks her name — 'Valentina Orlova. Do not answer.' Intimate, performance-driven; continues the rendered shot_01 beat directly into story.

title: DIAL M FOR MOON — Hook B: The Inspection
tagline: ONE FREQUENCY. TWO EMPIRES. NO SIGN-OFF.
concept: Daylight inspection of Object 10-D; everything pristine and false. Valya pockets a log page showing an unassigned signal instead of reporting it. Institutional thriller — the engine is how long she can hide what she knows.

title: DIAL M FOR MOON — Hook C: Two Empires
tagline: ONE FREQUENCY. TWO EMPIRES. NO SIGN-OFF.
concept: Cross-cut from frame one: Valya at Object 10-D and an American operator at a U.S. listening station hear the same impossible signal. The tagline made literal; the film becomes a race to answer first.
